 Availability of submissions 
 Work submitted to arXiv undergoes a series of quality assurance checks as part of  moderation . This helps authors by ensuring their work will be discoverable and archivable and helps readers find relevant research that is in a consistent, readable format. 
 Quality assurance checks can take between one to four days to resolve, sometimes longer. Authors will be notified by email if any issues are found in the submission. Authors will also receive an email when the submission is posted publicly. 
 Submissions to arXiv are typically posted publicly Sunday through
Thursday, with no announcements Friday or Saturday. You can check the  current arXiv
time , which also shows the next deadline. Submissions are made public as part of the  scheduled announcement process . This includes new submissions as well as  replacements ,  withdrawal notices ,  cross listings  and  journal reference .  
    
 A note about arXiv-id assignments 
 The final  arXiv identifier  is assigned as part of the automated process when the work is announced. It is not possible to generate or to be provided with the arXiv identifier or DOI in advance. Submitting authors will receive an email when the work is announced and it will appear on their account dashboard. 
  Note:  The arXiv identifier cannot be back-dated, so identifiers will be assigned in the month of first announcement. It may be the case that a submission appears in a different identifier month than its original submission date due to various factors.

      var bar = document.querySelector('.ds-site-header');
      var md = document.querySelector('.md-header[data-md-component="header"]');
      if (!bar || !md) return;
      var brand = bar.querySelector('.ds-site-header-brand');
      // Our .ds-site-header ALSO carries material's `md-header` class, so material's
      // own .md-header search CSS keeps drawing the input + full-width results panel
      // exactly as upstream. Just move the live search node here (after the brand);
      // its behaviour is unchanged — no custom panel CSS.
      var search = md.querySelector('.md-search');
      if (search && brand) brand.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', search);
      // Group the docs controls — color-theme toggle + the relocated search-toggle —
      // into one cluster appended to the END of the bar (after the nav), so on desktop
      // they sit at the far right exactly as before. Order within the cluster: theme
      // toggle, then the magnifying-glass to its right.
      // Material's mobile search-toggle (the magnifying-glass) lives DIRECTLY in
      // .md-header — not inside .md-search — so without relocating it, it stays in the
      // hidden .md-header and mobile users lose the only control that opens the search
      // overlay. Keeping the cluster OUTSIDE the collapsible nav means both controls
      // stay visible on mobile (the nav collapses behind the hamburger); a CSS flex
      // order rule keeps the hamburger itself rightmost there. Material hides the
      // magnify ≥60em, so on desktop the inline search input remains the search
      // affordance and only the toggle shows here — no duplicate.
      var host = document.createElement('div');
      host.className = 'ds-docs-controls';
      var palette = md.querySelector('[data-md-component="palette"]');
      if (palette) host.appendChild(palette);
      var searchToggle = md.querySelector('.md-header__button[for="__search"]');
      if (searchToggle) host.appendChild(searchToggle);
      bar.appendChild(host);
      // Drive material's site-nav drawer (#__drawer, a pure-CSS toggle) from the header
      // hamburger, and mirror aria-state however the drawer is toggled. Esc closes it.
      var drawer = document.getElementById('__drawer');
      var navToggle = document.getElementById('ds-nav-toggle');
      if (drawer && navToggle) {
        var setDrawer = function (open) {
          drawer.checked = open;
          drawer.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
        };
        navToggle.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          setDrawer(!drawer.checked);
        });
        drawer.addEventListener('change', function () {
          navToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', drawer.checked);
          navToggle.setAttribute('aria-label', drawer.checked ? 'Close navigation' : 'Open navigation');
        });
        document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
          if (e.key === 'Escape' && drawer.checked) { setDrawer(false); navToggle.focus(); }
